title: WHO GETS CREDIT OR BLAME? ATTRIBUTING ACCOUNTABILITY IN MODERN AI SYSTEMS

bias_targets.methodology: Tracing spurious correlations between gender and target labels (e.g., gender with blonde hair in images, or the term 'male' with toxicity in text) to specific training stages by calculating the Accountability Attribution Score (AA-Score) and evaluating confounder log-likelihoods.

Using the Accountability Attribution Score (AA-Score) to identify training stages that disproportionately contribute to spurious associations between religious identity terms (e.g., 'Christian') and toxicity labels in text classification.

Evaluating the causal effect of specific training stages on the model's reliance on racial identity terms (e.g., 'black') when predicting text toxicity, validated through stage-skipping retraining experiments.
